initial_description: Water damage in the kitchen. A pipe burst suddenly and flooded the room.
adjuster_notes: Inspected property. Confirmed a sudden and accidental pipe burst. The damage matches the claim. The house is occupied.

initial_description: Fire damage to the detached garage.
adjuster_notes: Garage burned down due to an electrical fault. Loss is covered. Limit for other structures needs to be checked.

initial_description: Water damage to the living room ceiling from a roof leak.
adjuster_notes: The leak is NOT from the roof. I found a slow leak in the upstairs bathroom plumbing that has been continuously seeping for 20 days. Wood rot is present.
Police report provided. Forced entry confirmed. Stolen items verified.

initial_description: Extensive water damage to floors due to continuous seepage. Customer states they have the HO-2306 endorsement.
adjuster_notes: Confirmed continuous seepage for 25 days. The policyholder has the HO-2306 endorsement. However, the property has been completely vacant for the last 90 days.

initial_description: Wind damage to the roof, several shingles blown off.
adjuster_notes: Wind damage confirmed from recent storm. No interior water damage.
Damage is due to a sinkhole collapse under the property. Earth movement confirmed.

initial_description: Water damage in the basement. Customer claims a pipe burst.
adjuster_notes: The damage was NOT caused by a pipe burst. It was caused by surface water flooding from heavy rain outside.

initial_description: Slow leak under the sink causing cabinet damage. Customer has HO-2306 endorsement.
adjuster_notes: Confirmed continuous seepage lasting 15 days. Property is occupied (not vacant). Customer has HO-2306 active.

initial_description: Lightning struck a tree which fell on the fence.
adjuster_notes: Lightning strike confirmed. Fence (other structure) damaged.
